sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 350. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Paralyzes for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 100 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Applies Anguish Collapse (Ability Power decreases by 50 when attacking an enemy not in Break, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, disables Unison gauge filling effects) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
